description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeTimesheetListSearchFilterParams' used for filtering and sorting employee timesheet list search results within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for employee numbers and actionable states, with methods for setting and retrieving these properties, as well as initialization of default sort parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetListSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee timesheet lists based on employee numbers and actionable states, with default sorting by start date in descending order.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 'timesheet.startDate' and sort order descending.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers used as filter criteria.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers used as filter criteria.

methods.name: getActionableStatesList
methods.description: Returns the list of actionable states used as filter criteria.

methods.name: setActionableStatesList
methods.description: Sets the list of actionable states used as filter criteria.
